decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0014-ctrl-all (with his 1.1 and 1.2 updates), for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's OS 1.74 port site (0x400378c2, 6 stock bytes, jmp ctrl_all_gate) became an address, length and SHA-256 guard in build.json's 1.74 release.
The OS 1.73 source and site are not imported: core-ar2 0.3 is for OS 1.74 only.
include/ar2-1.74.inc keeps its path relative to the source, so the .include line in src/ctrl-all.s is unchanged.
